title: Chronicle of John of Nikiu (Ge'ez version); RU: «Хроника» Иоанна Никиусского
author: John, bishop of Nikiu
date: c. 690s CE; Ge'ez translation 1602 from a lost Arabic version
size: 122 chapters; c. 70k words (estimate; Charles c. 200 pp.)
ru_evidence: ru.wiki «Иоанн Никиусский» lists only Charles's English; absent from the vostlit index. Russian studies only quote passages (Мингазов 2012 on Kubrat; Холод 2023–24).
value: The only Egyptian narrative of the Arab conquest of Egypt (chs. 111–121). Also has unusual traditions on Cambyses, the Argead kings, Alexander and the Ptolemies.
ai_feasibility: Low-medium. Ge'ez is weak in LLMs; Zotenberg and Charles are the controls, and an Ethiopist reviewer is required.
pilot_unit: Chs. 111–121 (Arab conquest), c. 12k words; or the Cambyses-to-Ptolemies chapters, c. 5k words.
